svg.metadata: {"story":"Moses","act":3,"chapter":"Ch.3 · Before the Throne","scene":"B","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Moses stands before Pharaoh, and the plagues come: water to blood, frogs, gnats, flies, and the rest, until the firstborn cry out.
